steps.text: A switch is what lets us turn a circuit on and off. Let's see how it controls the current.
Toggle the switch on and off and watch the bulb.
Switch ON closes the circuit — a complete loop — so current flows and the bulb glows. Switch OFF opens a gap, so the current stops.
A switch simply makes or breaks the loop. That's how every light and appliance in your home is turned on and off.

coach.mission: Use the switch to turn the circuit on and off.
whenStuck: Toggle the switch and watch the bulb react.
ON closes the loop; OFF opens it.
whenWrong: Switch ON completes the loop (bulb glows); OFF breaks it (bulb off).
A switch makes or breaks the circuit.
whenCorrect: Right — closing the switch let current flow and lit the bulb.
Good — opening it broke the circuit.
coach.done: You've seen how a switch controls a circuit. Explore more, or move on when you're ready.
